1.Title: The Grand Hunt
1.Info: Explore new unknowns, venture deep into the lair and dispose of the powerful creatures that spawn within. Only warriors that have tested and proven their strength may enter this domain.

2.Title: Temporal Rift
2.Info:
Undertake the sacred duty of repairing Temporal Chaos and obtain an abundance of resources!
In this place, every ending is a new beginning.

3.Title: Team Badge
3.Info:
Special Badges that have been blessed to provide various powerful effects.
Discover Enhanced Badges and create an even more powerful team!

4.Title: Temporal Beacon
4.Info:
Items transformed by the Temporal Armillary can enhance a Hero's Talents.
Mix and match different effects and attributes to shape a growth path that's entirely your own.

5.Title: Temporal Armillary
5.Info:
Gathering and conducting repairs will improve space-time stability, yielding even greater resources!
The more resources you possess, the stronger you will become!

6.Title: Raven Whisperer
6.Info: Grief drives my hunger. Pain makes me howl. The indelible scars of agony and despair shall stay with me forever.

7.Title: Sanctioned Realm
7.Info:
Hypogeans are sewing secret seeds of doubt in the minds of lesser warriors.
Quickly, nip these schemes in the bud, time is running out!
